scope: First independent review of frozen coverage data source, including the root-authorized TRAIN40 bootstrap addition; no runtime or data-content validation

source_findings.legacy_TRAIN40: Only contract.train_keys['40'] are indexed from the immutable completed legacy manifest. _legacy gathers file stats for those120 records, including their supervised targets; old DEV/test records are never selected. Frozen scaler values and manifest SHA must match before reuse.
source_findings.bootstrap: request_bootstrap_contract/ bootstrap_TRAIN40/ read_bootstrap_TRAIN40 operate on oldTRAIN120 metadata plus fixedDEV60 names only. phase=train40_only and complete_shared660=false prevent confusing this scope with full660 preparation. No acquisition receipt/raw identity is included, so ongoing downloads cannot change bootstrap identity. The final accepted source map must remain frozen during this campaign.
source_findings.new_TRAIN160: New source targets are read only within root-released actual preparation, after coordinate/GRID alignment. Exactly12 ver/hor/tor U/S columns are parsed once per successful CAD preparation and cast to the established FP32 four-field format; no abs/sign/exporter transformation is introduced. The original frozen scaler is constructed, never fitted to new TRAIN or DEV.
source_findings.new_DEV20: DEV preparation reads CSV nodeID/coord_x/coord_y/coord_z only. No physical_path or target_path is produced for DEV input records. load_case rejects with_targets for any key outside the manifest TRAIN scope and permanently retains the separate DEV readout interface.
source_findings.input_compatibility: CSV GRID IDs are mapped bijectively by coordinates to original H5 rows within0.0002mm and checked against actual deck GRID coordinates, never GRID-1. Source reads only H5 vertices/cells. The reused feature_arrays implements the original25 arithmetic with real RBE2 CM, known3 actual expanded actions, MAT1 E/nu/rho and reference/interface distances; missing physical inputs are unsupported without defaults. Original FP32 bbox normalization, quadratic-boundary unique node cloud/BLAKE2b seed2026/no replacement/zero padding and pinned target-free29-channel R64 _stencil/_splat definitions are preserved.
source_findings.DEV_barrier: The deferred reader verifies the complete exact2400 arm:step:DEVcase inventory against the full input contract, every terminal JSON hash and fixed arm/step/key identity, permanently closed training, and either fullN finite encoded/physical4 shape/stat proofs or an explicit terminal failure reason. It cannot open DEV targets from bootstrap or a partial full-input manifest.
source_findings.shared_DEV_parse_resume: EachDEV CAD has a source_read_started claim before the source target parse and a committed owned target manifest after all three-load outputs. A completed owned CAD is reused; an uncommitted claim rejects silent source rereading. Actual attempts/completions and owned cache reads are separate native counters. Unknown/interrupted reads are not represented as successful predictions.
source_findings.release_and_identity: Both full preparation and bootstrap require the authentic passed root marker, exact scientific digest/source_pins and preparation_and_training_released=true. Full preparation additionally requires all540 completed canonical official-URL/byte/SHA/stat receipts and validates actual received byte hashes on first preparation. Completed CAD inputs retain their contract/file-stat identities on resume.
source_findings.forbidden_scope: No old DEV/final/blind/sealed-test/dia target, H5 nodal variable or strain target read path, scaler.fit invocation, model/checkpoint load, neural training or new physical solve is present. Source-only metadata entry points use stdlib; scientific dependencies are imported lazily in released actual paths.

runtime_limits_explicit: A source PASS does not claim the newly acquired CADs have supported cards/materials, valid aligned fields or successful GPU preparation; the first released actual preparation checks those fixed inputs.

Full shared feasibility requires every frozen new CAD. Unsupported input is a terminal readiness negative with fixed identities, not evidence that a solver family has converged or failed an accuracy target.

Bootstrap source identity is stable against acquisition progress, while any later scientific source-map change intentionally requires a new contract; final code pins must be frozen before actual training.
